_reference: A&D GX-A/GF-A Communication Manual, FX-i/FZ-i Interface Specification

packet_format._description: 17-character fixed format: HH,SWWW.WWW UUU CR LF

weight._description: Signed float including sign character, e.g. +001.234

unit._description: Right-aligned, 3 chars padded, e.g. '  g', ' kg', ' lb'

commands._note: Commands terminated with CR LF. ACK (0x06) returned if SiF/ErCd enabled.

output_modes._description: A&D scales support multiple transmission modes, configurable on the device
output_modes.continuous: Stream output on R command until ESC received
output_modes.stability_triggered: Send on S command when weight stabilizes
output_modes.polled: Send on Q command immediately regardless of stability
